name: ModelVariant824_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant824_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (between the start and end times a new bolt leaves a model point every period, up to the row's bolt count, and flies towards a jittered point on the opposing slot, wrapped in a ring of sprites and spinning Gouraud strips and trailing a ribbon and smoke puffs whose colours fade once it arrives; on arrival each bolt flares into a glow with two fans of rays, animated sparks and a growing sixteen-segment shock ring while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the bolts and shock ring and packs five texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the first bolt arrives, then 4 on every frame until 1 once after the end time when the last bolt has arrived, 2 once the last glow has faded after the light recovers and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-841 and 938 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
